description: The JSON API attribute member, expressing datapoint properties.

oneOf.description: The datapoint definition for an enumerated type.

valueType.description: The type of the value of this Datapoint, here used together with an enumeration, it must use *string*

value.description: The value of this datapoint, covers enumeration values. The 'value' member needs to be omitted if no value is present.

items.description: List of valid enumerations for the datapoint value, such as [a,b,c] or [true,false]. As a note, also the boolean type (true/false, up/down, ...) is an enumeration.

oneOf.description: The datapoint definition for a numbered type.

valueType.description: The type of the value of this Datapoint, here used together with a number, it must use *string*

value.description: The value of this datapoint, covers number values. The 'value' member needs to be omitted if no value is present.

minimum.description: Expresses an applicative minimal (int/float type) value (the minimum SHOULD be treated as greater or equal for a Datapoint value).

maximum.description: Expresses an applicative maximal (int/float type) value (the maximum SHOULD be treated as lower or equal for a Datapoint value).

resolution.description: Expresses a mapping to the next possible datapoint value as for a (int/float type) value, values larger than unsigned 16 bit makes no practical sense.

oneOf.description: The datapoint definition for an array type, combining numbered/enumeration types.

valueType.description: The type of the value of this Datapoint, here used together with an array, it must use *object*

value.description: The values of this datapoint, covers an array of string values (numbers are also handled as strings). The 'value' member needs to be omitted if no value is present.

description.description: Represents the description of a datapoint.

comment.description: A comment expressed in the MaC from the installer, in KNX for GA present but not for a GO.

readable.description: Specifies if a datapoint can be read from a client.

writable.description: Specifies if a datapoint can be written from a client.

timestamp.description: The time where this value was read or written at the server. The 'timestamp' member needs to be omitted if no value is present.

items.description: Additional type information of the datapoint, as URN and/or IRI (the latter with namespace prefix)
